source_class.radial_basis: cubic B-spline, degree 3, uniform knots in log r, clamped at both ends
source_class.azimuthal_basis: real Fourier [1, cos phi, sin phi, cos 2phi, sin 2phi, cos 3phi, sin 3phi]; phi is the source-plane azimuth in the AART convention after the registered rigid pi/2 offset
source_class.temporal_basis: DCT-II global cosine modes cos(pi k u), u = (t - t_min)/(t_max - t_min), zero outside
source_class.normalization: unnormalised design columns; every reported rank and spectrum is of the whitened operator, not of the basis
source_class.modification_forbidden: the registered primary class is not to be modified in E3C; enrichment happens only in E3D on nested classes

radial_support.rule: r_inner = min over retained rays of source_r, r_outer = max, taken across the three orders of that geometry after subsampling
radial_support.why_this_is_stated: if the primary radial knots move with spin, a source-domain change is confounded with a spacetime change. The primary class is preserved as registered and the confound is measured, not assumed away, by the common-support control below.

control.rule: one fixed interval in r/M contained in the valid domain of all three anchors, with identical knot locations in r/M; rays outside it are dropped from the control operator only

radial_support.emission_support_disclaimer: near-horizon ray coverage does not imply the emissivity model physically emits to the horizon. Ray-map support and assumed source emission are separate objects.

localized_probe.form: Gaussian in retarded age, flat in the emission annulus
localized_probe.normalization: unit L2 norm over the emission region, so the reported Fisher information is not in units of an arbitrary peak amplitude

observation.subsample: stratified in (screen azimuth, source radius, delay) with quadrature rescaled so each band's total solid angle is preserved

common_age_grid.formula: A_max = T_obs + 1.25 * max_{g,n} {Q_0.999^Omega, Q_0.999^I} + 2h, rounded up to a multiple of the age step

measurement_model.datum: z_p = dOmega_p * g_p^3 * j(r_p, phi_p, t_p) + eta_p
measurement_model.noise: Var(eta_p) = sigma_Omega^2 * dOmega_p, i.e. white noise of density sigma_Omega per unit solid angle
measurement_model.whitened_row: sqrt(dOmega_p) / sigma_Omega * g_p^3 * B(r_p, phi_p, t_p)
measurement_model.equivalent_pixel_average_form: y_p = g_p^3 j_p + eps_p with Var(eps_p) = sigma_Omega^2 / dOmega_p produces the same whitened row
measurement_model.sigma_rule: one noise density for the whole audit, fixed from the direct arm's clean response to the declared reference source. No arm may choose its own sigma.
measurement_model.derived_arm_covariance: y_U = L y_R with C_U = L C_R L^T; y_F = S y_R with C_F = S C_R S^T; C_R = sigma_Omega^2 diag(dOmega)
measurement_model.retired: the flat per-row sigma convention with c = g^3 is retired as pixelization-dependent

arms.RESOLVED_PHYSICAL: orders n=0,1,2 as separately observed channels
arms.UNRESOLVED_IMAGE: orders summed into one image plane, C_U = L C_R L^T
arms.TOTAL_FLUX: all spatial information collapsed, C_F = S C_R S^T
arms.DELAY_ONLY: physical per-ray delays, direct-order spatial mapping
arms.SPATIAL_ONLY: physical spatial mappings, direct-order delay field
arms.EQUALIZED_ORDER_SENSITIVITY: coordinates and delays preserved; only the declared order normalization altered
arms.PAIRING_DESTROYED: delay, position and weight permuted independently within an order; a nonphysical negative control, never an alternative architecture

registered_gates.G9w_transfer_weight_semantics: per order, the operator's response to the declared unit source with the declared row noise removed equals sum(dOmega * g^3) computed independently; tolerance 1e-10
registered_gates.E3C_v2_no_reserved_e3d_fields: no E3C table carries a name reserved for E3D
registered_gates.E3C_v2_exact_rank_not_applicable: every rank-reporting table carries exact_rank = NOT_APPLICABLE
registered_gates.E3C_v2_dispositions_are_registered: every disposition is one of the registered values
registered_gates.E3C_v2_depth_contract_complete: the depth tables carry the supremum, the contiguous depth and the mask

operator_notation.Q_C: the synthesis map of the declared class C
operator_notation.rule: every rank, nullity, singular value and conditioning reported by E3C is a property of A_C. Nothing about mathcal A follows from a spectrum of A_C.

depth_contract.oldest_detectable_age_probe: sup { a : SNR_0^2 I(a) >= rho^2 }, a supremum over a possibly non-contiguous detectable set
depth_contract.largest_contiguous_detectable_depth: length in M of the longest run of consecutive detectable ages, reported with its endpoints; the span a reconstruction can use
depth_contract.age_threshold_mask: the complete boolean detectability mask over the common age grid
depth_contract.retired_name: T_rec, which did not say it was a supremum

rank_conventions.exact_rank: NOT_APPLICABLE for float64 physical operators absent a structural certificate; none exists here
rank_conventions.numerical_rank: LAPACK default: sigma > max(m, d) * eps * sigma_max, eps = binary64 machine epsilon. A decision at a tolerance, not an algebraic rank
rank_conventions.operational_rank: count of sigma >= rho with rho = 1.0, on the operator scaled to the reference SNR
rank_conventions.effective_rank: exp of the entropy of the normalised spectrum
rank_conventions.separation_required: numerical, operational and effective rank are distinct quantities and are never substituted for one another

depth_definition.right_censoring: a depth equal to A_max is right-censored and reported as T_rec >= A_max; it is a lower bound, not a measurement
depth_definition.forbidden: the raw maximum ray delay is not a historical depth

historical_innovation.J_old: integral over a > A_0_0.999 of log(1 + I(a)) da, trapezoidal on the common age grid
historical_innovation.lower_limit: the direct order's registered 99.9% throughput-weighted age boundary, per geometry
historical_innovation.delta_G_indirect: G_resolved - G_direct; report rank, trace, stable rank and smallest positive eigenvalue on its image

aggregation_rules.surface: the full 4x3 spin-by-inclination surface is reported cell by cell
aggregation_rules.statistics: median, minimum, maximum, and whether the trend is monotone; edge cases named
aggregation_rules.forbidden_language: these are deterministic registered geometries, not samples from a population. No p-values, no confidence intervals, no significance claims across cells.
aggregation_rules.pairing_destroyed: report the full 16-seed distribution, never a single favorable permutation
aggregation_rules.matched_sensitivity: all 19 aligned-window fractions retained, with median, IQR, overlap fraction and the count of unsupported fractions
aggregation_rules.no_asymptotic_law: n = 0, 1, 2 does not determine an asymptotic exponent and none is fitted

frozen_after: no basis, support, SNR grid, age grid or threshold may be changed after the first non-canary geometry is evaluated
